lines.trans: Mr Chun Yuqiao, the head of the partner agency has arrived.
Send him in, go on with your work, and close the door from outside.
What did you do to Jia Zhe?
This clip is from just one camera—we have footage from two other angles as well.
Let us keep the conversation civil, shall we?
I have called a psychologist for him, yet in his current state he cannot work for now.
His phobia of water is something your agency never should have hidden from us.
